findings.title: Joined raw overflow compaction omits the original caller's activity
findings.description: The raw overflow path registers its activity only in lifecycle.before. condenseContext may join an identical pending generation without calling that caller's lifecycle.before, so its release remains undefined and the run getter remains false while it awaits the shared summary and while its own publication/PostCompact executes.

related.role: Join key excludes lifecycle and caller signal; it is enabled for a plain policy without prepare/estimateContextTokens.
Existing generation is awaited instead of executing this caller's generateContext/lifecycle.before.
Only registration point in the raw overflow route.
Each caller still executes its own final publication hook.

counterexample.reachability: The declared runTurn(TurnOptions) interface accepts a plain CompactionSetup policy and independent run signals. No same-session exclusivity is enforced in runTurn. This route is already exercised by the overflow fixture in turn/session.test.ts:620. The shared-generation branch is intentional in condenseContext.
prerequisites: Two raw overflow callers use the same sessionId, prompt/workspace, history, policy values and optional operation source/identity.
Neither policy supplies prepare or estimateContextTokens, so the in-process key is enabled.
Both have an admitted legal cut, with threshold checks kept below threshold by a large contextWindow.
The first generation is held while the second reaches recovery.
counterexample.keyEvidence: Both calls pass operation {sessionId, source, identity} at turn/session.ts:405. Identical source history and deterministic openingMessage produce identical captured messages. digest uses JSON.stringify; caller signal and lifecycle are not included in the key. The second therefore reuses pendingCompactions.get(key).
counterexample.observedFromCode: Second caller never executes its lifecycle.before and never calls compaction.begin. Its isCompacting getter is false during the pending shared summary and its own PostCompact.
counterexample.fixtureTarget: Append inside existing runTurn tests using options/drain/CONTEXT_OVERFLOW_PREFIX already defined in packages/ts-shell/src/turn/session.test.ts.

findings.guardrail: Register each original overflow caller at an admitted legal-cut boundary that also runs when generation is joined. Retain that caller's token through its own commit, onCompact and PostCompact, releasing in finally. Reuse the existing compaction owner and pending-generation mechanism; do not start activity before legal-cut admission or introduce a second execution/state owner.
findings.confidence: High from the concrete key and control flow; proposed fixture has not been executed.
